# Compatibility status

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-status.mjs from lib/providers/*.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

What works today when a link tries to open an assistant with a prompt. "Opened" and "prompt arrived" are separate questions, so they are separate tables.

**No provider documents a prefill URL.** Everything marked *observed* is undocumented behavior and can change without notice.

| Level | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ✅ documented | The provider's own documentation describes it. |
| 🟢 observed | Seen working in device tests or by several third parties. Undocumented: it can break at any time. |
| 🟡 conflicting | Sources disagree. Needs a device test. |
| ⚪ unverified | Plausible, but no reliable report either way. |
| ❌ unsupported | Known not to work, or no mechanism exists. |

## Native app opens from a link

| Assistant | iOS | Android | Desktop |
|---|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT | 🟢 observed | 🟢 observed | ⚪ unverified |
| Claude | 🟢 observed | 🟢 observed | ⚪ unverified |
| Gemini | 🟢 observed | ⚪ unverified | ❌ unsupported |

## Prompt arrives in the chat box

| Assistant | iOS | Android | Desktop |
|---|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT | 🟢 observed | 🟢 observed | 🟢 observed |
| Claude | 🟢 observed | 🟢 observed | 🟢 observed |
| Gemini | 🟡 conflicting | 🟡 conflicting | 🟡 conflicting |

## Sent without the person tapping send

| Assistant | Evidence | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT | 🟢 observed | Signed in: fills the composer only. Signed out: sent immediately. |
| Claude | ❌ unsupported | Never sent by itself in device tests, signed in or out. |
| Gemini | ⚪ unverified | No prefill by default, so nothing to send. |

## Launch variants

| Assistant | Variant | URL | Evidence | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT | `chatgpt-web-q` | `https://chatgpt.com/?q={prompt}` | 🟢 observed | yes | Undocumented ?q= parameter. Device-tested: fills the composer when signed in; sends immediately when signed out. |
| ChatGPT | `chatgpt-web-q-temporary` | `https://chatgpt.com/?q={prompt}&temporary-chat=true` | 🟢 observed | no (experimental) | Community-reported flag; keeps the chat out of history. |
| ChatGPT | `chatgpt-open` | `https://chatgpt.com/` | ✅ documented | yes | Opens the provider's normal entry point. No prompt is transferred; the person pastes it. |
| Claude | `claude-web-q` | `https://claude.ai/new?q={prompt}` | 🟢 observed | yes | Undocumented ?q= parameter. Device-tested: fills the composer, never sends. A direct camera scan on iOS lost the message. |
| Claude | `claude-native-scheme` | `claude://claude.ai/new?q={prompt}` | 🟢 observed | no (experimental) | Custom scheme. Opened the app with the message on iOS and Android. Fails if the app is not installed, so it should never be a default. |
| Claude | `claude-open` | `https://claude.ai/new` | ✅ documented | yes | Opens the provider's normal entry point. No prompt is transferred; the person pastes it. |
| Gemini | `gemini-open` | `https://gemini.google.com/app` | ✅ documented | yes | Opens the provider's normal entry point. No prompt is transferred; the person pastes it. |
| Gemini | `gemini-web-q` | `https://gemini.google.com/app?q={prompt}` | 🟡 conflicting | no (experimental) | Claimed by one generator site; most reports say it needs an extension. |
| Gemini | `gemini-guided-learning-query` | `https://gemini.google.com/guided-learning?query={prompt}` | ⚪ unverified | no (experimental) | Reported by an education blog (Dec 2025). Changes Gemini's mode. |

## Per assistant

### ChatGPT

- **Last verified:** 2026-11-11 (device-tested)
- **Sign-in:** No for the web: signed out, the message is sent immediately (observed 2026-11-11). The app requires an account.
- **Fallback:** Copy prompt, then open chatgpt.com.
- **References:**
  - [Tenable TRA-2025-22 — ChatGPT prompt injection via ?q=](https://www.tenable.com/security/research/tra-2025-22) (security-advisory): Confirms q= is read by the web UI and (at the time) auto-submitted.
  - [OpenAI community — Query parameters in ChatGPT](https://community.openai.com/t/query-parameters-in-chatgpt/1027747) (third-party): Reports ?q=, &hints=search, &temporary-chat=true.
  - [OpenAI community — Deep linking for Custom GPTs (feature request)](https://community.openai.com/t/deep-linking-for-custom-gpts-with-url-parameters-launch-context/1370871) (third-party): Shows there is no official, stable deep-link mechanism.

### Claude

- **Last verified:** 2026-11-11 (device-tested)
- **Sign-in:** Yes. Signed out, desktop Chrome kept the message through sign-in; Android Chrome lost it at the login page (2026-11-11). The clipboard copy covers that case.
- **Fallback:** Copy prompt, then open claude.ai/new.
- **References:**
  - [Oasis Security — Claudy Day (claude.ai/new?q= prompt injection)](https://www.oasis.security/blog/claude-ai-prompt-injection-data-exfiltration-vulnerability) (security-advisory): Describes /new?q= as pre-filling the chat box; hidden-HTML injection was fixed.
  - [starlight-llm-actions — provider strategies](https://holdenhewett.github.io/starlight-llm-actions/getting-started/concepts/) (third-party): Claims ?q= broke in Oct 2025 (unsourced). Uses clipboard-open for Claude.
  - [Drafts directory — claude:// URL scheme action](https://directory.getdrafts.com/a/25n) (third-party): Reports claude://claude.ai/new?q= opening the desktop and mobile apps.

### Gemini

- **Last verified:** 2026-11-11 (device-tested)
- **Sign-in:** Yes — Google account required.
- **Fallback:** Copy prompt, then open gemini.google.com/app. This is the default for Gemini.
- **References:**
  - [Google Help — Use learning tools in Gemini Apps](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16448384) (official): Official docs describe typing the prompt; no URL prefill is documented.
  - [gemini-url-prompt (Chrome extension adding ?prompt= / ?q=)](https://github.com/elliot79313/gemini-url-prompt) (third-party): Exists because Gemini has no built-in URL prefill.
  - [u2l.ai — Gemini prompt link generator](https://u2l.ai/tools/gemini-prompt-link-generator) (third-party): Claims ?q= works natively. Contradicts the above; unverified.
